CustomField.formula: IF( TEXT(Account.Account_Status__c ) = "Active - Agency" || TEXT(Account.Account_Status__c ) = "GSI Customer" || TEXT(Account.Type ) = "Agency" || NOT(ISBLANK( Account.ParentId )), "Yes","No")
CustomField.inlineHelpText: If Account Status is "Active - Agency" or "GSI Customer", or Type is "Agency", or if there's a Parent Account, then this will be "Yes". This field will be used for determining whether Terminations are necessary when terminating Posting Accounts.
CustomField.label: Agency?
